name: internal-comms
tagline_zh: 写周报、领导更新、事故报告总被退回？这个技能内置你公司的格式模板，让 AI 直接产出符合内部调性的草稿。
tagline_en: Tired of rewrites for internal updates? This skill bakes in your company's formats so AI drafts status reports.
desc_en: A set of resources to help me write all kinds of internal communications, using the formats that my company likes to use. Claude should use this skill whenever asked to write some sort of internal communications (status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, incident reports, project updates, etc.).
why_zh: 它不教你写，而是直接套用你公司的格式模板，连 3P 更新和 FAQ 都覆盖，比通用写作工具更懂内部语境。
why_en: It doesn't teach writing—it applies your company's exact formats, covering even 3P updates and FAQs, so drafts fit internal.
